vulnerabilities.description: Token is fetched via getAccessTokenSilently() but never added to fetch headers. Request sent with only Content-Type header.
vulnerabilities.impact: API cannot verify user authentication; should fail server-side but represents broken auth protocol
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add: headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token; before fetch at line 61

vulnerabilities.description: Token fetched but never added to request. Evidence upload at line 138 lacks Authorization header.
vulnerabilities.impact: File upload lacks user authentication; server-side RLS should protect but client-side auth incomplete
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add Authorization header to fetch request

vulnerabilities.type: Missing Authentication Token in Chat API
vulnerabilities.description: Token fetched at line 270 but not added to headers in chat requests (lines 115, 273)
vulnerabilities.impact: Chat messages sent without authentication; RLS enforcement depends entirely on server
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add token to headers before fetch requests

vulnerabilities.description: Token fetched but not added to headers. Document generation at line 59 lacks Authorization.
vulnerabilities.impact: Generation endpoint unauthed; payment verification at risk if server-side validation is weak

vulnerabilities.description: Token fetched but not used in payment intent creation at line 153
vulnerabilities.impact: CRITICAL: Payment requests lack authentication; users could potentially create payment intents for other users
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add Authorization header before payment API call

vulnerabilities.description: data.response from API rendered directly without sanitization in fact summary generation
vulnerabilities.impact: Malicious API response or MITM attack could inject arbitrary JavaScript

vulnerabilities.description: Document title constructed from doc.affiantName, doc.documentTitle without sanitization
vulnerabilities.impact: If database contains user-controlled XSS payload, it executes in browser
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Ensure data is text-only; use textContent instead of innerHTML

vulnerabilities.description: validation.normalizedCounty, validation.reasoning rendered directly from API
vulnerabilities.impact: Compromised API or MITM could inject XSS payload via validation response
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Sanitize all API responses before rendering

vulnerabilities.description: File validation uses file.type check only. No magic-byte verification or server-side validation visible.
vulnerabilities.impact: Attacker can upload malicious files by spoofing MIME type; depends entirely on server validation
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement server-side: verify magic bytes, validate content type, scan for malware

vulnerabilities.description: API error messages displayed directly to user without sanitization
vulnerabilities.impact: Error details could reveal system internals, file paths, or database structure
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use generic error messages; log details server-side only

vulnerabilities.description: skipPayment flag sent to server based on NODE_ENV. Server must enforce payment independently.
vulnerabilities.impact: If server trusts client flag for payment skipping, payments could be bypassed in production
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Never trust client. Enforce payment based on server-side subscription/tier status only.

vulnerabilities.description: Form inputs lack validation before submission. Relies entirely on server-side Zod validation.
vulnerabilities.impact: UX issue; server-side validation should catch but client-side validation provides early feedback
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add Zod schemas to client-side forms

vulnerabilities.description: console.log statements throughout codebase log user data, tokens, and state in production
vulnerabilities.impact: Sensitive info exposed in browser console; could be captured by monitoring tools
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Remove all console.log before production; use proper logging service

vulnerabilities.description: Auth tokens stored in localStorage accessible to JavaScript; TOS status in localStorage
vulnerabilities.impact: Standard for browser apps; mitigated by short token expiry and server-side validation
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use httpOnly cookies where possible; implement auto-logout on inactivity

vulnerabilities.description: ReactMarkdown renders Terms of Service; low risk if content is from trusted source
vulnerabilities.impact: Low; ensure markdown never includes user input
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Verify TOS content is immutable and from trusted source

summary: Critical authentication issues found: 5 API endpoints have missing Authorization headers despite tokens being fetched. Multiple XSS vulnerabilities from unsanitized API responses. File upload validation is client-side only. Server-side security (RLS, Zod, OAuth) appears adequate but client-side authentication protocol is broken.
recommendations: 🔴 URGENT: Fix all 5 missing Authorization headers immediately - audit every fetch() call
🔴 CRITICAL: Sanitize ALL API responses before rendering - implement DOMPurify library
🔴 CRITICAL: Implement server-side file validation - verify magic bytes, scan for malware
🟠 HIGH: Remove sensitive console.log statements before production deployment
🟠 HIGH: Never trust client payment flags - enforce payment via server state only
🟡 MEDIUM: Add comprehensive error handling that doesn't expose system details
🟡 MEDIUM: Implement CSP headers to mitigate XSS impact
🟡 MEDIUM: Add client-side form validation with Zod schemas
🟢 LOW: Use httpOnly cookies for session tokens instead of localStorage
criticalFindings: Missing Auth Headers: CountyValidationInput.js:55, EvidenceUploadModal.js:128, ChatInterface.js:270, GenerateButton.js:57, PaymentModal.js:151
XSS Risks: ChatInterface.js:126 (API response), UserDashboard.js:165 (user data), CountyValidationInput.js:73 (validation response)
Payment Risk: GenerateButton.js:65 sends skipPayment flag to server
File Upload: Only client-side MIME validation at EvidenceUploadModal.js:80
positiveFindings: ✓ Secrets in environment variables, not hardcoded
